description: Admin UI for both entry modes on the HRMS attendance screen: (1) a single-day 'Add / edit attendance' dialog, and (2) a bulk back-fill grid over a date range. Both call the FEAT-003 edge actions via hrRequest(...), audit the write client-side, and invalidate the attendance queries so the Monthly view, My Attendance, command center and payroll immediately reflect the back-filled days. Depends on FEAT-003.
steps: Extend AuditEntity in src/lib/audit.ts to include 'attendance' (union: ... | 'attendance'). No migration needed (audit_log.entity_type is free TEXT).

In src/routes/_authenticated/hrms/attendance.tsx, add a shared helper to call the edge function via hrRequest from src/lib/attendance-client.ts (import it). Use useQueryClient to invalidate queries after a successful write: invalidate ['hrms-attendance-month'], ['hrms-attendance-day'] (and any other attendance query keys used on this screen) so the Monthly table and per-employee calendar refresh. Use toast (sonner, already imported) for success/error, matching existing patterns.

Single-day dialog: add a new 'Add / edit attendance' button in the Monthly view header area (next to DownloadButton / MonthNav) that opens a Dialog (shadcn Dialog, already imported). Fields: employee Select (reuse useEmployees(); show employeeName + code, exclude INACTIVE like the rest of the screen), work_date Input[type=date] (max = today), login Input[type=time], logout Input[type=time] (optional), and an optional note Textarea. On submit call hrRequest({ action: 'admin_set_attendance', employee_id, work_date, login, logout: logout || null, note }). On success: toast, logAudit({ actorId: user.id (from useAuth), action: 'edit', entity: 'attendance', entityId: employee_id, entityLabel: employeeName+date, detail: a human summary, meta: { work_date, login, logout } }), invalidate queries, close dialog. Surface server {ok:false,message} as a toast (hrRequest throws the message).

Also wire the admin per-employee calendar for single-day editing: the MonthlyView already renders <MonthCalendar days={open.days} /> inside the per-employee Dialog. Pass an onDayClick handler to that MonthCalendar that pre-fills and opens the single-day 'Add / edit attendance' dialog for open.employee and the clicked date (so an admin can click a day in an employee's month to correct it). Keep this ADMIN behavior (edit any day) distinct from the employee-side onDayClick (raise a request) — only wire it on the admin screen. Note MonthCalendar only fires onDayClick for ACTIONABLE_DAY_KINDS in src/components/hrms/attendance-month.tsx; if admins need to click additional day kinds (e.g. an existing 'present' day to correct it), widen the clickable set in a backward-compatible way — EITHER add an optional prop (e.g. clickableKinds or allowAnyDay) to MonthCalendar defaulting to the current ACTIONABLE_DAY_KINDS behavior so the employee side is unchanged, OR document that admin edits are reached via the dialog button. Prefer the optional-prop approach so no existing caller changes behavior.

Bulk back-fill grid: add a second button 'Bulk back-fill' opening a larger Dialog. Controls: a from-date and to-date Input[type=date] (default to the 1st of the current month through today-1, both capped at today) and an employee picker (default to all active employees, or let the admin pick one employee to fill across the range — choose the matrix that stays usable for ~5 employees x ~11 days: recommended is one row per (employee x date) OR an employee-select that then shows a date-rows table with login/logout time inputs per day; keep it consistent with existing shadcn Table styling on this screen). Render time inputs (Input[type=time]) for login and logout per cell/row. A '+ copy down' or sensible default is optional, not required.

Bulk submit: collect only rows where a login time was entered (skip blanks), build entries: [{ employee_id, work_date, login, logout: logout||null }], call hrRequest({ action: 'admin_bulk_set_attendance', entries }). On return, show a per-row success/failure summary from results (e.g. toast '9 days saved, 1 skipped' plus an inline list of failures with their message), logAudit a single 'edit' entry summarizing the bulk back-fill (entity 'attendance', detail with range + count, meta { from, to, written, failed }), invalidate the attendance queries, and keep the dialog open showing results so the admin sees what failed. Do not clear successfully-written rows' feedback.

Validation UX: mirror the server rules client-side for immediate feedback (disable submit when no valid rows; show inline 'logout must be after login' etc.) but treat the SERVER as the source of truth — always surface server messages. Do not duplicate business logic beyond light guards; the edge function + shared validator are authoritative.
Keep everything additive: do not change the Today/Security/Devices tabs or the existing Monthly table columns/export. The new buttons and dialogs are the only additions to the screen.
acceptance_criteria: An admin can open 'Add / edit attendance' from the Monthly view, pick employee+date+login(+logout+note), submit, and see the day created/updated (query invalidation refreshes the Monthly table and calendar)
Clicking a day in an employee's month calendar (admin screen) opens the single-day dialog pre-filled with that employee and date
An admin can open 'Bulk back-fill', choose a date range (e.g. 1st-11th), enter login/logout per employee per day, submit once, and receive a per-row success/failure summary; blank rows are skipped
Successful writes are audited via logAudit with entity 'attendance' and actorId = current admin
Server validation/permission messages are surfaced to the admin as toasts; a non-admin cannot write (403 from the edge function)
The Today/Security/Devices tabs and existing Monthly columns/CSV export are unchanged; ./node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit, bun run test and bun run build all pass
findings:
Admin UI added entirely within the Monthly tab of src/routes/_authenticated/hrms/attendance.tsx (strictly additive; Today/Security/Devices tabs and the existing Monthly columns/CSV export are untouched). Two new outline buttons sit in the MonthlyView header row, to the LEFT of the existing DownloadButton/MonthNav: 'Add / edit attendance' (CalendarPlus icon) and 'Bulk back-fill' (CalendarRange icon).

SINGLE-DAY (AttendanceEntryDialog, max-w-md): employee Select (active employees via new useActiveEmployees(today) helper = excludes INACTIVE resigned/terminated and anyone not joined by `today`, shows `name · code`), work_date Input[type=date] max=today, login Input[type=time], optional logout Input[type=time], optional note Textarea. Client guards: submit disabled unless employee+date+login present and not logout<=login (inline 'Logout must be after login.' hint). Submits hrRequest({ action:'admin_set_attendance', employee_id, work_date, login, logout: logout||null, note: note||undefined }). On success: toast, logAudit({ actorId:user.id, action:'edit', entity:'attendance', entityId:employee_id, entityLabel:`name · date`, detail, meta:{work_date,login,logout} }), invalidate, close. Server {ok:false,message} is thrown by hrRequest and surfaced via toast(getErrorMessage).

CALENDAR WIRING: MonthCalendar gained an optional `allowAnyDay?: boolean` prop (default false) — when true AND onDayClick is set, EVERY day cell is clickable with neutral aria-label `Edit attendance for ${date}` (otherwise unchanged ACTIONABLE_DAY_KINDS + `Raise a request for ${date}`). The admin per-employee Dialog now passes allowAnyDay + onDayClick to open the single-day dialog prefilled with open.employee.id and the clicked date. Employee-side caller (onDayClick without allowAnyDay) and admin read-only callers are byte-for-behavior identical.

BULK (BulkBackfillDialog, max-w-2xl): chose the ONE-EMPLOYEE × date-rows layout (recommended) — pick a single employee Select + From/To Input[type=date] (default 1st-of-current-month .. today, both max=today), then a shadcn Table with one row per date in the range, each row having login + logout Input[type=time]. Only rows with a login are submitted (blanks skipped); inline red border + warning when any logout<=login. One submit -> hrRequest({ action:'admin_bulk_set_attendance', entries:[{employee_id,work_date,login,logout:logout||null}] }). On return: toast summary ('N saved, M failed, K blank skipped'), an inline per-row failure list (date: message) kept visible in the dialog (dialog stays OPEN after submit), a single summary logAudit (meta {from,to,written,failed}), and invalidate. dateRange() iterates on UTC-midnight cursors (capped ~400) to avoid zone drift on date-only strings.

Query invalidation after any write: invalidateAttendance() invalidates ['hrms-attendance-month'] and ['hrms-attendance-day'] (prefix match) so Monthly grid, per-employee calendar, Today tab, My Attendance, payroll and command center all refresh. Added imports: useEffect (react), Input, Textarea, hrRequest (@/lib/attendance-client), logAudit (@/lib/audit), icons CalendarPlus/CalendarRange/AlertTriangle. Extended AuditEntity union in src/lib/audit.ts with 'attendance' (no migration — entity_type is free TEXT). Ran prettier --write on the three touched src files to satisfy the eslint prettier/prettier rule. Verification all green: ./node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit clean, eslint clean on touched files, bun run test 285/285 (incl. the shared-copy byte-identical attendance-rules test — rules files NOT touched), bun run build ok.
